title: Risk defaults (10 ETH exposure cap vs 0.01 ETH snipe size) and the other inventory thresholds, including how risk settings are parsed

options.name: Keep current defaults and parsing
options.risk: A malformed MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE, DAILY_LOSS_PCT, SNIPE_COOLDOWN_MS, MAX_POSITION_SIZE or per-chain max capital silently turns that limit off (AUD-DB-001); the 10 ETH exposure cap is about 800 x the funded wallet and cannot bind; the block-age defaults do not follow their stated 5x rule (TH-DB-11).

options.name: One typed parser and one default per key, used by riskManager, preflight and the dashboard, refusing to boot on non-numeric, non-finite or out-of-range values; default values unchanged
options.behavior_impact: A bad value stops the bot at boot with a message instead of disabling a limit; the dashboard shows exactly what is enforced.
options.risk: A .env that boots today with a typo will refuse to boot; every risk key is touched in one change.

options.name: Change specific defaults (for example an exposure cap scaled to the snipe size or the wallet, per currency; block-age tolerances that follow one rule)
options.behavior_impact: The changed limits bind in normal operation; more snipes may be refused.
options.risk: Without the parser change and the accounting fix (card OD-58) a new default can still be disabled by a typo or mis-measured.

options.name: Both: one strict parser and the chosen new defaults
options.behavior_impact: Limits that bind and cannot be turned off by a typo.
options.risk: Largest behaviour change; needs the accounting fix (OD-58) first so that new defaults measure what they say.

recommendation: Research recommendation (research SUMMARY OD-25): surface the defaults in the thresholds inventory and leave them unchanged unless decided. Audit note for the decision: the daily-loss and exposure limits do not currently measure what their defaults describe (AUD-DB-002, AUD-DB-003, card OD-58), so a choice of values is only meaningful after that is fixed; the parser question (align-one-parser) is independent of the values. Context (added at the 22-21 Task 3 close-out, supplied by the execute-phase orchestrator; not an operator ruling, ESC-DB-01): decide this card treating today's daily-loss and exposure limits as NOT working. The daily-loss breaker and the exposure cap mix decimal native-unit buy amounts with wei sell and gas amounts (AUD-DB-002) and skip positions held after a failed sell (AUD-DB-003), so changing their default values changes nothing until those are fixed (card OD-58).
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides which risk limits can bind, what a malformed setting does, and the default values of every flagged threshold row.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion before Wave A (capital fixes), after card OD-58
